objective: Define deterministic synthetic expected traces for nominal spontaneous, induction and protracted birthing pathways, including progression and deterioration while waiting/in transit, intervention event separation, deterministic event order and stale-event cancellation. Bind to runtime only in B1.2.
steps: Define separate deterministic synthetic cases for nominal spontaneous, induction and protracted pathways, with explicit patient and service states at each event.

Include progression while waiting and in transit, induction/intervention decisions distinct from progression, deterioration while waiting or in transit, and one stale event invalidated after a state change.
Keep event times as synthetic simulation ticks and state an explicit deterministic event-order key; include no clinical thresholds, probabilities, hazard parameters or site defaults.
Add standard-library unittest controls for fixture shape, scenario coverage, waiting/transit expectations, ordering, event identity and forbidden clinical-rate fields.
Run packet validation, the focused unittest file, staged diff check and Conductor integrity checks. Record that these tests validate the oracle fixture only, not birthing runtime behavior.
Obtain reviewer-agent review before coordinator acceptance. B1.2 must bind these oracles to the executable Rust runtime and record expected failures before implementation.

verification.oracle: B1.1 packet binds to accepted A5.4/B0.4 prerequisites and exact context hashes.
All fixture contract cases and negative controls execute and pass; no runtime behavior is claimed.
Staged fixture, tests, packet and evidence contain no whitespace errors.

acceptance: Nominal, induction and protracted synthetic pathways have unique, deterministic expected event traces.
The traces include patient progression during service waits and transit, explicit intervention and deterioration event distinctions, and stale-event cancellation expectations.
Tests reject malformed event time/order/identity and any accidental introduction of clinical probabilities or hazard rates.
Evidence states these are expected trace contracts only; executable runtime binding and observed red-to-green behavior remain a B1.2 gate.
Reviewer-agent/subagent finds no remaining oracle ambiguity or overclaim at the exact commit.
stop_conditions: A case requires an invented clinical timing/threshold/probability
A trace obscures progression during wait/transit or collapses intervention with deterioration
Any edit escapes the exact write paths
